Subject: Important Update: Upcoming Office Move Next Month

Hi Team,

I am writing to share some exciting news: our office will be moving to a new location next month! This move is part of our strategy to provide a more collaborative and modern workspace for everyone.

Please review the following details carefully to ensure a smooth transition:

**New Office Address:**
123 Innovation Drive, Suite 400
Tech City, TC 90210

**Key Moving Dates:**
*   **Pack Up Deadline:** Friday, October 20th at 5:00 PM
*   **Last Day at Current Office:** Friday, October 20th
*   **First Day at New Office:** Monday, October 23rd

**Your Responsibilities:**
To keep the process organized, please complete the following tasks by the Pack Up Deadline:
1.  **Personal Items:** Pack all personal belongings, photos, and non-essential items into the provided boxes. Label each box with your name and department.
2.  **IT Equipment:** Do not disconnect your computer or monitor yet. The IT team will handle the disconnection and reconnection of all hardware. Please ensure your desk is clear of loose cables.
3.  **Shared Spaces:** Clear out the shared kitchen and breakroom areas. Please remove any personal food items from the fridge and cabinets by the end of the day on October 20th.

We will send out a detailed floor plan and seating chart for the new office next week. If you have any questions or special requirements regarding your workspace, please let me know by this Friday.

Thank you for your cooperation and flexibility as we make this transition. I am confident that the new space will greatly benefit our team’s productivity and morale.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Job Title]
